fields.Short Description: A Robert Trent Jones Sr. classic from 1949 that has hosted the U.S. Women's Open, the Senior PGA Tour Championship and the PGA Tour's Myrtle Beach Classic.

fields.Name: Dunes Golf & Beach Club

fields.Name: Long Bay Golf Club
